This structural top-line decay stands in stark contrast to the sector median sales growth of 11.8% [E71], proving the business is aggressively losing ground while its peers expand. Compounding this operational failure, the company generates severe losses and capital destruction, evidenced by a deeply negative ROE of -37.69% and ROA of -33.21% [E7, E8], driving a negative P/E of -9.96x [E5] and rendering its zero dividend yield entirely unsurprising [E3].
